description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A 3D printing technician needs to verify the geometric complexity of a cranial reconstruction before printing. Your task is to: (1) Generate a 3D surface of the skull using the standard 'Bone' mask preset (226-3071 HU); (2) Export the surface as a binary STL file to '/home/ga/Documents/skull.stl'; (3) Locate the surface properties/information panel in InVesalius to find the mesh statistics; and (4) Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/mesh_stats.txt' recording the exact number of triangles, volume, and surface area displayed in the software. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
